policy: Aggregators are discovery-only under the current Germany V9 evidence policy. The previously recorded 0.62 EUR/kWh Seety observations are therefore not eligible station-pricing evidence and have been removed from entries. No Reload-Solution tariff may be ranked until an operator-controlled/public direct-payment payload, official tariff sheet, AFIR/Mobilithek price component, or equivalent EVSE-level primary evidence is obtained.
note: Both DE*RLS and DE*RSL occur in BNetzA under Reload-Solution GmbH. Their shared physical operator identity does not imply a shared price.
